IGOR Photography

$2,395 collection

Dallas–Fort Worth wedding photo and video studio with appointment studios in Fort Worth and on McKinney Avenue in Dallas. Wedding-day collections and elopement coverage are both priced on the collections page.

Wedding day coverage starts at $2,395 in Dallas–Fort Worth. Elopement coverage is listed at $695 per hour, or $795 per hour on Saturdays, for 1–4 hours. Engagement and bridal portraits are $695 for up to 2 hours. Wedding video starts at $1,495. · Source · checked 2026-10-03 · published

4912 Lodgepole Ln, Fort Worth, TX 76137; also 3839 McKinney Ave, Suite 155, Dallas, TX 75204
